name: The Table of Four
text: Follow a Friday-night Commander playgroup from casual 1v1 precons to a dramatic four-player championship pod.

chapters.name: Chapter 1: Friday Night Precons
chapters.text: Sleeve up a green giant precon and settle into your first night at the table.

nodes.name: Sam's Goblin Box
nodes.text: Sam brought his first mono-red precon straight out of the box.
nodes.before: Fresh out of the box! Let's see if your giants can block a goblin mob.
nodes.after: Alright, Ghalta hits like a truck. Next game I'm adding more haste!

nodes.name: Maya's Lifegain Sanctuary
nodes.text: Maya loves gaining 20 life before turn six.
nodes.before: Commander damage is the only thing I'm scared of — try getting through!
nodes.after: Okay, 21 commander damage really does bypass forty life. Well played!

nodes.name: Between Rounds at the LGS
nodes.text: The store owner sets out a binder of Commander staples before the evening's main event.

nodes.name: Devon's Rakdos Spectacle
nodes.text: Devon always brings the loudest deck at the kitchen table.
nodes.before: No slow games tonight — everybody takes damage, including me!
nodes.after: You survived the spectacle! Next week we're bringing our upgraded lists.

chapters.name: Chapter 2: The Upgrade Arms Race
chapters.text: Everyone cracked packs and tuned their commanders. Take the helm of a Boros legion.

nodes.name: Sram's Equipment Bench
nodes.text: Sam swapped to Voltron equipment and draws cards off every sword.
nodes.before: Look at these shiny swords. One unblocked swing and it's curtains!
nodes.after: Going wide beat going tall this time. Respect.

nodes.name: Gruul Stampede
nodes.text: Devon went bigger and faster with trampling beasts.
nodes.before: Why play removal when every creature is a 6/6 with trample?
nodes.after: Double combat steps caught me completely tapped out!

nodes.name: Meren's Graveyard Engine
nodes.text: Maya built a relentless Golgari sacrifice loop.
nodes.before: Kill my creatures all you want — they come right back on my end step.
nodes.after: You raced the graveyard engine before it locked the board!

chapters.name: Chapter 3: Table Politics
chapters.text: The whole group sits down together. Master timing, interaction, and multiplayer threat assessment.

nodes.name: Combo Sparring
nodes.text: Practice holding up interaction against an explosive combo deck.
nodes.before: If you tap out on turn four, I'm going off.
nodes.after: Clean counterspell discipline. You're ready for the four-player pod.

nodes.name: Friday Night 4-Player Pod
nodes.text: Your first full four-player Commander pod with Sam, Maya, and Devon.
nodes.before: Four commanders, forty life each. Don't make yourself the archenemy too early!
nodes.after: What a table! Everyone's bringing their flagship deck for the championship pod.

chapters.name: Chapter 4: The Championship Pod
chapters.text: Flagship dragons, legendary synergies, and the ultimate four-player showdown.

nodes.name: Token Armada Warmup
nodes.text: Face a tuned token swarm before the finals.
nodes.before: My board goes twenty creatures wide by turn five.
nodes.after: Dragons fly right over the swarm!

nodes.name: The Championship Pod
nodes.text: Defeat all three rivals in the grand four-player Commander finale.
nodes.before: Final pod of the season! No holding back — show us who rules the Table of Four.
nodes.after: Champion of the Table of Four! Same time next Friday?
